newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold price sharply down, boosting demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold price sharply down, boosting demand.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose to 1,730 kg on Wednesday from Tuesday's 1,510 kg as sharply lower prices boosted demand, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $319.60 an ounce and 1,679,000 lira per gram, compared to Tuesday's $325.00 and 1,689,000 lira, following lower prices on European markets.
The Turkish lira closed weaker at 163,190 to the dollar, versus the previous close of 162,200. The lira's weakness prevented a sharper drop in gold prices in lira terms.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,420 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 50.6 percent conducted in dollar terms.
